translations.web: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
translations.bsb: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
translations.kjv: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
translations.asv: and he that sat was to look upon like a jasper stone and a sardius: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, like an emerald to look upon.
